capabilities: Mention @claude or @codex on a line to ask questions or request note edits
Chat with agents in conversation notes that record messages, tool calls, and approvals
Comment on passages and have an agent act on the comments
Use vault SKILL.md and AGENT.md files as skills and subagents
See which text agents wrote with the contribution lens
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Tested on macOS, desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.13+. The plugin is free but agent usage is billed under the user's Anthropic or OpenAI account. Version 0.5.0 changed command IDs and split wiki/threads modules into separate Yami plugins.
motivation: The author built it because coding agents are useful beyond code but running them in a terminal is a poor place to work with notes.
problem: Coding agents like Claude Code and Codex can read and edit notes, but they run in a terminal, which is a poor place to work with notes.

relations.evidence: Duet uses your own Claude Code or Codex installation and login.
Work with Claude Code or Codex inside your Obsidian notes.
Duet runs on Yami, a library that other plugins such as Yami Wiki and Yami Threads also use.

requires.name: Claude Code CLI or Codex CLI
Anthropic or OpenAI account for the agent CLI

summary: AI agent integration that runs Claude Code or Codex inside notes via @mentions, conversation notes, and comments, with live co-editing.
